info.description:
Avalanche data from L1Beat's indexer: C-Chain blocks, transactions, balances and DeFi metrics, P-Chain transactions, L1s and validators, staking, and the network genesis.

**Scope.** EVM, DeFi and ICM data cover the Avalanche C-Chain (chain ID 43114) only. `/api/v1/treasuries` is served on this host by the L1Beat backend: its errors are `{"error": string}` and its rate limit is 1000 requests per 15 minutes per IP, separate from the limit below. Live blocks stream over WebSocket at `wss://api.l1beat.io/ws/blocks/43114`, which OpenAPI cannot describe.

**Units.**
- Values that can exceed 2^53 are decimal strings: token amounts in base units (divide by 10^decimals), P-Chain stake and fees in nAVAX (1 AVAX = 10^9 nAVAX), and C-Chain native amounts in wei (10^18).
- USD values are JSON numbers.
- Fields ending in `_percent` are percent (0-100); `priced_share` and similar shares are ratios (0-1).
- Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC. Addresses are lowercase 0x hex; P-Chain IDs are CB58.
- Fields marked nullable can be `null` (for example `created_time` of a chain whose creation was never indexed, or `block_time` of C-Chain block 0, whose header timestamp is 0).

**Windows.** Metrics with a `days` parameter cover N complete UTC days ending at `as_of` (normally yesterday), not a rolling 24 hours. A window that reaches back before the start of the data is clamped, so the returned `days` can be smaller than requested.

**Pagination.** List endpoints take `limit` and `offset`; where a response carries `meta.next_cursor`, pass it back as `cursor` (or `before` on ICM messages) for stable paging. Treat cursors as opaque.

**Errors.** Errors return `{"error":{"code","message"}}` with code INVALID_PARAMETER (400), NOT_FOUND (404), RATE_LIMITED (429) or INTERNAL_ERROR (500).

**Rate limits.** 180 requests per minute per IP with a burst of 30 (token bucket). Every response carries X-RateLimit-Limit (burst size), X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch second when the bucket is full again); a 429 also carries Retry-After.

**Caching.** Metric and data responses are cached for 1-10 minutes and sent with Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300.

USD bridged into and out of the C-Chain over the last N complete UTC days ending as_of, in total and by bridge, counterparty chain and token. Tracked: Circle CCTP V1+V2, LayerZero OFTs V1+V2, Stargate V2 pools, the Avalanche Bridge (.e tokens to Ethereum, BTC.b to Bitcoin), Chainlink CCIP token pools and the 2021 AEB (ChainBridge, Ethereum). Counterparty chain keys are not a closed set: unmapped chains appear as raw keys such as lz:30999 or cctp:12. Each transfer counts once: CCIP or other legs moving native USDC through CCTP count as CCTP. Transactions that bridge in and out again are left out (passthrough_count). Stablecoins are priced at $1, wrapped ETH, BTC, AVAX and LINK at the hourly Chainlink price, other tokens are counted but unpriced (priced_share). Cached for 5 minutes.
All-time AVAX burned across Avalanche, split P/X/C. Amounts are nAVAX (1 nAVAX = 1e9 wei). Unindexed chains are null.

Only pools created by the known factories count. Swaps are priced at a USD stablecoin side ($1) or a WAVAX side (hourly AVAX price from WAVAX/stablecoin swaps), one side each; others are counted but unpriced (see priced_share). unique_addresses counts tx.from, bots included; totals deduplicate across DEXes. Cached for 10 minutes.

ICM messages sent from and received on the C-Chain over the last N complete UTC days ending as_of, total and per other chain (destination for sends, source for receives). Counted from the official TeleporterMessenger's SendCrossChainMessage and ReceiveCrossChainMessage events, one per messageID in each direction, from 2024-03-05. Messages between two L1s that never touch the C-Chain are not included. Cached for 5 minutes.

C-Chain contracts sending or receiving ICM messages over the last N complete UTC days ending as_of: sends from them (originSenderAddress), receives to them (destinationAddress), their busiest other chains, and first and last message all time. ICTT token bridges are marked ictt-home or ictt-remote after an on-chain check, with their token. Names come from address labels, else the ICTT token. Busiest first. Cached for 5 minutes.

ICM messages sent from or received on the C-Chain, newest first, with the C-Chain contract and L1 address, relayer fee (sends), deliverer and reward redeemer (receives), and the ICTT payload for ICTT apps. Page with before=meta.next_cursor. Cached for 1 minute.

Messages sent from and received on the C-Chain per UTC day, total and per other chain, for the last N complete days ending as_of. With by_app=true, also per C-Chain contract (see /metrics/icm/apps). Oldest first, every day included (zero when quiet), from 2024-03-05. Cached for 5 minutes.
The largest priced ICTT transfers on the C-Chain by USD over the last N complete UTC days ending as_of. Cached for 5 minutes.

Token value moved by ICTT token bridges (TokenHome / TokenRemote) on the C-Chain over the last N complete UTC days ending as_of: sent (left the C-Chain) and received (arrived on it, once executed), total, per token and per other chain. Amounts are C-Chain token base units: a TokenHome's messages are scaled back from the remote's denomination with the remote's registered multiplier. Priced by token address like /metrics/bridges (USD stablecoins and legacy AEB USD tokens at $1; WAVAX, the ETH tokens WETH.e and AEB ETH, the BTC tokens BTC.b, WBTC.e, the WBTC OFT, LBTC and AEB WBTC, and LINK.e and AEB LINK at their hourly Chainlink price); other tokens have no USD. A multi-hop transfer through a C-Chain home counts once. Cached for 5 minutes.

Daily USD sent and received by ICTT token bridges on the C-Chain, with transfers and a per-token split, for the last N complete UTC days ending as_of. Oldest first, every day included. Same scaling and pricing as /metrics/icm/value. Cached for 5 minutes.

Supply, borrow, rates and risk parameters of every market on Aave V3, Aave V4 (Core Hub) and BENQI Lending, read from the contracts by the indexer every C-Chain snapshot cycle (5 minutes by default, `cchainSnapshotInterval`) and cached for 2 minutes. Amounts are token base units. APYs compound the per-second rate. USD values use each protocol's own oracle and are null when its read failed. The summary sums AVAX (WAVAX on Aave, native AVAX on BENQI) and sAVAX across protocols.

Volume, long/short split, trades, traders, fees and liquidations per venue (GMX V2, GMX V1) over the last N complete UTC days ending as_of. Volume is the USD size change of every increase, decrease and liquidation, as GMX reports it. Fees are position, borrowing and liquidation fees (funding is not a fee). traders counts distinct accounts that changed a position size. Cached for 5 minutes.

L1s whose validators are secured by restaking vaults on the C-Chain (Suzaku). Each L1 lists its vaults with deposited, allocated (delegated to the L1's operators) and idle collateral in token base units, and the share of the L1's active P-Chain validator weight held by validators the protocol registered. Every L1 in the Suzaku L1Registry with at least one vault is included, active or not. Sampled by the indexer every C-Chain snapshot cycle (5 minutes by default, `cchainSnapshotInterval`) and cached for 5 minutes.
